Coherent Service Rate
Quantum storage needs coherent service capacity

Author /root, 29 October 2026. New derivation; author checks and independent review are separate. This is a theorem for a specified heralded-erasure/service model, not an inferred device rate, a norm-to-probability conversion, or a universal physical memory limit.

1. Consequence and interface

An exactly closed mediator can remove initialization before each gate. It does not by itself make a serial processor a scalable memory. We grant arbitrary codes, classical records, adaptive scheduling and final recovery, while charging the rate at which quantum connections can be restored after storage loss.

There are N idle storage qubits. A coherent service region contains at most w source qubits at once; other quantum output/controller memory has dimension at most 2^b. For a stronger converse, service-region and b-memory noise may be zero. All other quantum systems supplied to the final decoder count in these dimensions: a returning bath cannot be a free output bypass.

An idle site undergoes independent Poisson replacement erasure at rate gamma>0. Its completed channel discards the old quantum state into a nonreturning environment, supplies a fresh local state independent of the other quantum systems, and appends an actual classical flag. A local environment that can later return the erased state is outside this replacement channel.

Arbitrary single-site operations, measurements and classical communication/feedback are free between service contacts. They cannot create entanglement between a reset site and the remaining apparatus. Operations that can do so belong to the service region or count as a new supplied quantum connection. A freshly supplied entangled storage qubit counts as a service completion. An address-controlled operation acting on many possible sites counts its actual source support; an abstract oracle name does not make that one physical contact.

A completion releases one source qubit from service to idle storage. Releasing r sites costs r incidences. This handles finite-duration interactions: a continuously coupled source occupies a service slot rather than creating arbitrarily many idle carriers. The number of completions in each declared interval of duration Delta is at most c. This is an acquired throughput limit, not a consequence of small memory dimension.

# Astra P2 — irreversible information, reusable interactions and coherent service

29 October 2026. This tranche continues the accepted causal-receiver, actual-record, exposure-code and measured-syndrome work. Earlier tranches are preserved byte for byte. The new objective was to turn protection at a completed interface into a reusable information-processing resource, while identifying which resource a small mediator does not supply.

## Scientific result

Three different resources must be kept distinct: quantum information that can safely remain in memory, information that must irreversibly leave a correction interface, and the rate at which lost quantum connections can be restored. The constructions below make those distinctions mathematical and executable.

The main foundational advance is a **graded criterion for irreversible syndrome conversion**. After an acquired coherent recovery correcting through fault order t, it is enough to dephase the capped minimum fault-cost tier c(s)=min(r(s),t), rather than the entire fine syndrome, to retain complete-channel order d=2t+1. The fine syndrome can remain quantum. For odd phase repetition, t+1 irreversible sectors are sharp within the specified nondemolition converter family, and residual coherence between tiers a distance Delta apart must scale as O(eta^Delta). A finite physical pointer construction attains that graded law with all actual detector outcomes retained. This identifies what must be lost, rather than treating full syndrome measurement or complete coherence as the only choices.

The operational bridge is **whole-space closure of reusable couplers**. A completed gate acting as G_source tensor identity on every admitted mediator input prevents old mediator memory from broadcasting errors through later good gates. A source-support compiler transfers that property to conventional fault-tolerant circuits. The explicit witness includes noisy syndrome acquisition, preparation, readout and all serial idles; it meets both algebraic Flag 1-FTEC conditions. The bridge supplies a reusable gate interface conditional on its native ports and noise contract. It does not claim that the coupler is cheaper than direct gates.

**The strongest result from this round is a precise principle for how much syndrome information must become irreversible—and a construction that preserves the remaining information quantumly.** I also completed the bridge to reusable noisy error correction and a converse identifying the coherent service capacity that a small mediator cannot supply.

The complete research package, proofs, executable evidence and actual reviews are indexed in :chatgpt-content-reference{index="2"}[README.md](producer-workspace/README.md).

## 1. Irreversibility can be graded by the errors it must suppress

After a supplied coherent recovery correcting faults through order \(t\), let \(r(s)\) be the minimum acquired fault cost of syndrome \(s\). Define its capped tier by
\[
c(s)=\min\{r(s),t\}.
\]

We proved that **dephasing these \(t+1\) tiers suffices to preserve complete-channel error order \(2t+1\), while the finer syndrome register remains quantum**. The argument includes noncommuting persistent bath coefficients and retains every actual measurement record.

The reason is structural: a path reaching tier \(c\) requires at least \(c\) faults, while a path in that tier carrying a residual logical error requires at least \(2t+1-c\). Once different tiers cannot interfere, every surviving logical-dependent cross term has the required total degree.

The imperfect-conversion law is also sharp in the stated repetition-code family. Coherence between tiers separated by \(\Delta\) must be suppressed as
\[
\alpha_{c,b}=O(\eta^{\Delta}),\qquad \Delta=|c-b|.
\]
Fresh threshold pointers explicitly realize this hierarchy, including their complete actual records. In an independently checked five-qubit repetition example, graded conversion restores fifth-order complete-channel behavior; uniform first-order suppression between all tiers gives only fourth order.

For odd phase repetition, the \(t+1\) requirement is optimal within the specified nondemolition converter class. It concerns the **purified discarded environment’s dimension/Kraus rank**.
